content: .{@-राष्ट्रः@} ‘the great kingdom’, <ab>N.</ab> of a country in the west of India, the country of the Marāṭhās. .²2 the people of Mahārāṣṭra, the Marāṭhās (<ab>pl.</ab>). . ({@-ष्ट्री@}) <ab>N.</ab> of the principal Prākṛta dialect, the language of the people of the Mahārāṣṭra; <ab>cf.</ab> Daṇḍin:-- महाराष्ट्राश्रयां भाषां प्रकृष्टं प्राकृतं विदुः <ls>Kāv. 1. 34</ls>.
